fact: Lei 1/2024, gazetted 29 January 2024, institutes the National Interoperability Framework (QNI) with technical specifications regulating ICT use for interoperability of e-government services, applicable to all public institutions.

Lei 1/2024 grades the QNI's technical specifications as mandatory or recommended, and requires the mandatory ones to be adopted in all new IT products and projects of the public institutions it covers.
